title: Gap Analysis
description: Compare current state to desired future state and plan the bridge. Tests skills gaps, system gaps, and regulatory compliance.

seo.overviewTitle: Gap Analysis & As-Is vs To-Be State Assessment
seo.overviewBody: Gap analysis identifies what an organization needs to achieve its target goals. Senior business analysts demonstrate strategic insight by analyzing current state capabilities (As-Is), defining desired future state (To-Be), isolating operational deltas, and creating gap remediation roadmaps.

deliverables.title: 1. As-Is vs To-Be Gap Analysis Matrix
deliverables.desc: Structured matrix comparing current process capabilities against future requirements across people, process, and technology.

deliverables.title: 2. Capability Assessment & Delta Report
deliverables.desc: Analytical report detailing root causes of performance gaps and operational risks.

deliverables.title: 3. Strategic Gap Remediation Roadmap
deliverables.desc: Phased implementation roadmap outlining action items, resource requirements, and milestone timelines to bridge identified gaps.

faqs.question: What are the core steps in conducting a Gap Analysis?
faqs.answer: 1. Identify current state (As-Is), 2. Define target future state (To-Be), 3. Identify the gaps between states, 4. Develop an action plan to bridge the gaps.

faqs.question: What dimensions should be evaluated during a business gap analysis?
How do you prioritize gaps for remediation?
faqs.answer: Prioritize gaps based on business impact, risk severity, compliance urgency, and implementation cost.
